description: List the Alfa Laval machines that have a data sheet, one short line each (id, model, maker, type, variants, figure count, whether the model is on Dolphin's inventory sheet), optionally filtered by type ("disc stack", "self-cleaning", "manual-clean") and maker ("Alfa Laval"). Use it to find the right model, then call get_machine_datasheet. It carries no figures, no prices and no parts.

type.description: Optional machine type filter, e.g. "disc stack", "self-cleaning" or "manual-clean".

name: list_machines
title: List machines with data sheets
